result.question: For what does Micah's mother dedicate silver?

readings.answer: To make a graven image and a molten idol
readings.support: to make a graven image and a molten idol

assessments.reason: The passage states she dedicates the silver “to make a graven image and a molten idol,” which matches the key’s “To make an idol.”
The text also says she dedicates it “for my son’s benefit,” which directly answers “for what” in a different but text-supported way.
She says she dedicates the silver “to the LORD,” which can be answered as “for the LORD,” another valid reading of “for what.”

result.reason: The verse gives multiple distinct ‘for’ statements—“to the LORD,” “for my son’s benefit,” and “to make an idol”—so more than one materially different answer fits the question.
